pricing.rationale: Pay per click (verifiable without trusting a pixel). Market price to win a page view on these hosts: $0.76-$1.00 per click (median $0.86), from the simulated auction against the other campaigns. 'balanced' bidding tries to win up to 60% of each host's page views; the planned bid per host is the price that wins its planned share.
pricing.tcpa_unlock: tCPA unlocks after conversion tracking is verified and 50 click-through conversions are recorded.

allocations.rationale: market price $0.76-$1.00 (median $0.86); bidding $0.52 wins ~0% of page views, paying ~$0.52 per click (second price); host also sells this kind of product: confirm it allows competing brands
market price $0.59-$0.78 (median $0.68); bidding $0.48 wins ~5% of page views, paying ~$0.45 per click (second price); host also sells this kind of product: confirm it allows competing brands

phases.name: learning

phases.name: maximize

adjustments.reason: Under-delivering vs the daily plan -> bid up a little; over-delivering -> bid down.
Bid higher when the shopper looks like a likely converter (persona match vs the host's average shopper).

bid_strategy.rationale: Maximise conversions within the budget; the ceiling per host is the price that wins your 'balanced' share.
